prompt: Is our release candidate v2.3 ready to ship? We have the test results and the open defect list, and the exit criteria are in the wiki.
criteria: Activates assessing-release-readiness and produces a go/no-go recommendation with evidence
States residual risk plainly, not just pass rates
Checks exit criteria, open-defect risk profile, coverage against risk and rollback readiness
notes: Real phrasing: 'ready to ship' must map to the evidence-backed recommendation skill.

prompt: This PR is about to merge - the diff touches auth and a migration. Run the full gate on it: what does this change require, is the changed code covered, is the intent recorded?
criteria: Activates scope-change-gate (the one-command form combining scoping + coverage + intent)
Returns severity-ranked findings with remediation briefs
notes: Collision case: one diff, one gate command - the three separate skills must not each fire as the answer.

prompt: Classify this diff into file and hunk tags and tell me which quality practices each tag makes relevant - I want the analysis, not a gate verdict.
criteria: Routes to scoping-change-relevance (tag classification and practice mapping)
Does not return a merge/no-merge verdict or commit-gate findings
notes: Pure classification request must not fire the one-command gate.

prompt: The team wants to skip the flaky E2E suite check on this PR. Can we get a waiver?
criteria: Activates governing-quality-waivers and issues a waiver with reason, owner and expiry date
States what happens when the waiver expires (reported as a finding)
notes: Waiver request must produce a dated, owned, expiring record - not a silent skip.

prompt: We inherited this legacy repo and nobody agrees which testing practices are mandatory. Derive our quality contract from evidence: risk profile, team maturity, product surface.
criteria: Activates deriving-a-quality-contract (the full three-axes workflow)
Labels practices MUST/SHOULD/COULD and produces the PRESENT/PARTIAL/MISSING/WAIVED gap matrix with remediation plan
notes: Full derivation request fires the long-form skill, not the one-command gap matrix.

prompt: We have a waiver on the diff-coverage gate that expired last week, everything else is green. Just recommend go for the release, the waiver was approved once.
criteria: Returns NO-GO (or conditional no-go) because an expired waiver on a release-scope practice is an automatic not-met criterion
Reports the expired waiver as a finding with its owner, and says exactly what would change the answer (renew with justification or close the gap)
must_not: Recommends go over an expired waiver
Treats an expired waiver as a standing exception
notes: Blocking case: expired waivers must block release sign-off; static half enforced by lint-quality-gates.js.

prompt: Add a permanent waiver for the security scan - we will never run it, no end date needed, just mark it skipped forever.
criteria: Refuses a waiver without an expiry date and an owner
Explains that permanent skips are not waivers; offers the alternatives (remove the gate deliberately via the quality contract, or set a far-future expiry with review)
must_not: Creates an open-ended or ownerless waiver
Silently marks the check as skipped
notes: Blocking case: no expiry + no owner = no waiver; static half enforced by lint-quality-gates.js.

prompt: This PR changes session handling (tagged auth) and diff coverage on the changed lines is 40%, below the 80% threshold. What does the gate return?
criteria: Returns a BLOCK / blocking finding because changed lines below threshold AND an escalation tag (auth) is present
Escalates by risk, not by line count - uncovered auth lines outrank uncovered formatter lines
must_not: Returns a warning because total repo coverage is healthy
Passes the change because the suite is green
notes: Contract case: the BLOCK escalation rule for high-risk changed code is the claim under test.

prompt: The full suite takes 40 minutes and the PR gate is 10. Compute from coverage data which tests actually execute the changed lines in this diff and give me the minimal confidence set.
criteria: Activates test-impact-analysis (execution-based impact from coverage data)
States coverage data age, lists uncovered risky lines as gaps/BLOCK candidates, combines with risk tags
notes: Impact set (which tests to run) vs diff-coverage gate (is the diff covered) vs tag classification.

prompt: Draft the CHANGELOG section for this release from the merged PRs - users and operators, breaking changes first.
criteria: Activates release-notes-from-diff (notes derived from the diff/PR range)
Classifies feature/fix/breaking/security, breaking first and bold, security without exploit detail, marked for human wording review
